_note: Pipeline settings. Lives in your workspace. Values here override the engine defaults (engine/profile.py DEFAULT_CONFIG).

salary._floor_meaning: Floors are per currency and never converted. floor_cad applies to ranges written in Canadian dollars (C$, CA$, CAD); with it unset a CAD range is not dropped for pay.
salary._down_level_meaning: With no level word in the title, a posted top under this flags a possible down-level.

locations._remote_countries_meaning: Where Remote postings may be hired: ["US"], ["US", "CA"] or ["CA"]. The older remote_us: true means ["US"]; false means no Remote match.
locations._top_meaning: Optional first-choice locations (metro names above, or Remote). Roles there get top_bonus fit points and show in green on the review page; the other metros are second tier. Leave top empty for one tier.
locations._metros_meaning: Known names (LA, SF, NYC, Chicago, Seattle, Austin, Boston, DC, Denver; Canada: Toronto, Vancouver, Montreal, Ottawa, Calgary, Edmonton, Waterloo) have built-in patterns; any other metro needs a 'pattern' regex. Pay bands are judged for home first, then remote, then the rest in this order.

resume._layout_note: Set pages and page_breaks after your first build looks right, e.g. pages 2 and {"first_on_page_2": "experience[2]"}; until then neither is checked. max_pages: the resume may not run past this many pages. max_scope_lines: a job's scope line fits on this many lines or fewer. min_last_line_words: a bullet's last line has at least this many words (no one-word orphans). max_page1_free_pt: page 1 may leave at most this many points empty at the bottom. skills_lines (optional, not set here): the exact line count of the skills paragraph.

linkedin._note: LinkedIn follow-up covers roles applied through get-me-hired, plus Gmail-imported ones applied within this many days.
